subject: prd/docgate
statement: Where congruence debt exists immediately before a checked entry, docgate shall grandfather it by multiset subtraction over the key `(unit ID, mismatch class, field, projected value under FR-38, source-map value under FR-38)` and fail every after-key whose identical before-key multiplicity is exhausted.
rationale: exact identity makes baseline adoption decidable: unchanged debt stays green, but changing a wrong value or moving the disagreement cannot masquerade as no worse
fit_criterion: unchanged mismatch and byte-identical section restatement green; value replacement at constant count, field/class movement, and count increase red; count decrease and full repair green; projected units with no baseline lineage participate in the same key rule
